column1: # Beat Ledger - titles and artists as the INFINITAS score CSV of the KONAMI site writes them, where they differ from the game
# Columns (tab separated): song_id <TAB> title <TAB> artist <TAB> memo
#   song_id : INFINITAS internal music ID (5 digits)
#   title   : the title in the site's CSV, exactly (spaces at the end included)
#   artist  : the artist in the site's CSV, exactly
#   memo    : ignored by the program (the game's title / artist)
# Besides these the site writes "，" for "," in titles and artists (the client does that for every song).
# Used to write the CSV in the site's format and to match the site's titles when importing one. UTF-8, LF.
# Made from the SP / DP CSVs of two players (2026-11-24 and 2026-11-28, about 1,800 of the songs): songs not in them may differ too.
